crossRefs.note: Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
Hurry to answer me, Yahweh. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go…

translations.web: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.
translations.bsb: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
translations.kjv: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
translations.asv: Hear my prayer, O God; Give ear to the words of my mouth.
